description: Get arrest statistics from the FBI at national, state, or agency level. Offense codes are numeric: 'all' (all offenses), '11' (murder), '20' (rape), '30' (robbery), '50' (aggravated assault), '150' (drug abuse), and 40+ more. Returns counts or totals broken down by year, age, sex, race, ethnicity.
